_schema: Evidence-exhausted coverage records (atlas-crawler skill, 'Evidence-exhausted outcome'). One entry per entity + field where the deep-search loop genuinely ran and no bindable evidence exists: the entity's own site, its accelerator/partner pages, trade press and search were all checked. An exhausted gap stays counted as uncovered by scripts/crawl_gap_report.py (the gap report never hides it); this registry is what scripts/kpi_coverage.py uses to split gaps into 'exhausted' (a completed checklist outcome, not a failure) and 'open' (still to work). Entries are keyed by the gap-report scope_id and the exact entity id the scope emits (founder:<startup-slug>:<founder-slug>, partner:<slug>, startup:<slug> for the thin-records scope). Exhausted items leave the active worklist and are only re-chased when a new source enters the frontier. Seeded 2026-11-27 with the two cases adopted in the crawler skill.
